channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.39
- Fixes the paste-fallback popup remaining on screen after dictation finishes in another app. - Keeps transient messages dismissing after three seconds when Kiki returns from transcribing to idle. - Adds a deterministic HUD lifecycle check that reproduces and prevents this regression.

# Kiki 0.6.38
- Adds the Templeton Technologies product footer to the bottom of the Workbench navigation rail. - Keeps navigation independently scrollable while the footer remains anchored at every supported window size. - Matches the supplied compact reference with a 138-point wordmark and restrained label spacing. - Opens templetontech.com when the Templeton Technologies wordmark is selected.

# Kiki 0.6.37
- Matches the About footer to the smaller Radiant reference dimensions. - Removes hidden transparent padding from the Templeton Technologies artwork. - Uses the reference 14-point gap between the product label and wordmark. - Keeps the footer responsive at Kiki's compact supported window size. - Opens templetontech.com when the Templeton Technologies wordmark is selected.

# Kiki 0.6.36
- Rebuilds the Templeton Technologies footer on About as responsive app content. - Inherits Kiki’s About canvas color instead of using the darker sidebar color. - Preserves the supplied footer proportions while scaling the lockup with the window. - Keeps the complete footer reachable at Kiki’s compact supported window size.

# Kiki 0.6.35
- Rebuilt Home as a responsive workflow launchpad with consistent capability cards and contextual setup checks. - Clarified Voice Studio as a four-step record, install, create, and export workflow. - Added the Templeton Technologies product footer to About using the approved 698 × 318 layout. - Added a Check for Updates action to About and separate automatic checking and automatic download/install preferences in Settings. - Improved narrow-window behavior and added diagnostics for update controls, About actions, Home geometry, and Voice Studio workflow structure.
